- name: int_twilio__messages
      description: Unified Twilio messages with a normalized phone_number and day/week/month buckets derived from timestamp_sent; union of inbound and outbound subsets.
      grain: One row per message_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_twilio__message
      business_logic: '- Start from all rows in staging.stg_twilio__message. - Build the inbound subset by keeping rows where the direction string contains "inbound"; set phone_number to the sender (message_from); compute num_characters as the character count of body; compute body_no_spaces by removing the space character from body; retain all other fields as-is. - Build the outbound subset by keeping rows where the direction string contains "outbound"; set phone_number to the recipient (message_to); compute num_characters and body_no_spaces the same way; place the original sender (message_from) in the column named message_to; retain all other fields as-is. - Combine inbound and outbound with a UNION ALL; no de-duplication; output order is not defined. - Derive date buckets from timestamp_sent: date_day is the calendar date of the timestamp, date_week is the start date of the week containing the timestamp, and date_month is the first day of the month containing the timestamp. - Null handling: if body is NULL, num_characters and body_no_spaces are NULL; if timestamp_sent is NULL, date_day/date_week/date_month are NULL.'
      columns:
      - name: message_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique Twilio message identifier; exactly one output row per message_id.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: account_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Twilio account identifier associated with the message.
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp when the source message record was created.
      - name: timestamp_sent
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Message send timestamp used to derive date_day, date_week, and date_month.
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date corresponding to timestamp_sent.
      - name: date_week
        data_type: DATE
        description: Start date of the week containing timestamp_sent.
      - name: date_month
        data_type: DATE
        description: First day of the month containing timestamp_sent.
      - name: direction
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Original direction string; only rows where it contains 'inbound' or 'outbound' are included.
      - name: phone_number
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Normalized phone number: inbound uses message_from; outbound uses message_to.'
      - name: message_to
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Inbound rows retain the original recipient; outbound rows store the original sender.
      - name: body
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Message content from the source; NULLs preserved.
      - name: body_no_spaces
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Body with the space character removed; other whitespace and casing are unchanged.

      - name: error_message

      - name: messaging_service_id

      description: Message-level enrichment that left joins selected messaging service attributes and derives num_words from upstream fields.
      grain: One row per message_id; duplicates can occur if messaging_service_id matches multiple service rows
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_twilio__messages
      - intermediate.int_twilio__messaging_service

        data_type: VARCHAR
